_nota: Inglés de `measurement_guides.json` (`core/i18n.py`): castellano exacto → inglés, valor entero por valor entero. El fichero castellano no se toca; las claves, los ids y las frases literales de una fuente no se traducen. Lo aplica `i18n.localized` al servir.

strings.Ecografía: la ventana, los signos y la l: Ultrasound: the window, the signs and the checklist of each protocol are in their own panel.
strings.Tensión arterial con tensiómetro de braz: Blood pressure with an upper-arm monitor
strings.How to Prepare for the Test: How to Prepare for the Test
strings.No midas en los 30 minutos siguientes a: Do not measure within 30 minutes of a meal, caffeine or tobacco, nor just after exercise or at a time of stress.
strings.Descansa al menos 5 minutos antes de med: Rest for at least 5 minutes before measuring; 10 is better.
strings.Siéntate con la espalda apoyada, las pie: Sit with your back supported, your legs uncrossed and your feet on the floor.
strings.Apoya el brazo de modo que la parte de a: Support your arm so that the upper arm is at heart level. The arm bare, without a rolled-up sleeve squeezing it.
strings.Ajusta el manguito alrededor de la parte: Fit the cuff around the upper arm, with its lower edge 2.5 cm above the bend of the elbow.
strings.Toma 2 o 3 lecturas seguidas, con 1 minu: Take 2 or 3 readings in a row, 1 minute apart and without getting up, and note the time of each one.
strings.Cómo se adapta en microgravedad la postu: How the source's posture (seated, feet on the floor) is adapted in microgravity: no source that says so has been read. The steps are those for Earth.
strings.Limpia el termómetro antes y después de: Clean the thermometer before and after using it, with cold water and soap or with alcohol.
strings.Espera al menos 1 hora después de un eje: Wait at least 1 hour after intense exercise or a hot bath, and 20 to 30 minutes after smoking, eating or drinking something hot or cold.
strings.En la boca: la punta bajo la lengua y la: In the mouth: the tip under the tongue and the mouth closed, breathing through the nose and holding the thermometer with the lips. Leave it for 3 minutes or until it beeps.
strings.En la axila: coloca el termómetro, aprie: In the armpit: place the thermometer, press the arm against the body and wait 5 minutes or until it beeps.
strings.Apunta dónde la tomaste (boca, axila o f: Note where you took it (mouth, armpit or forehead): the figure changes with the site.
strings.Normal Results, en la lista de lo que ha: Normal Results, in the list of what makes normal temperature vary
strings.Qué termómetro hay a bordo y cómo se usa: Which thermometer is on board and how it is used in flight: no source that says so has been read. The steps are those for Earth.
strings.Saturación de oxígeno con pulsioxímetro: Oxygen saturation with a pulse oximeter
strings.Antes de medir, quita el esmalte oscuro: Before measuring, remove dark nail polish from the finger you are going to use: it blocks the device's light.
strings.Will I need to do anything to prepare fo: Will I need to do anything to prepare for the test?
strings.Pon el pulsioxímetro en la punta de un d: Put the pulse oximeter on the tip of a finger. The light may redden the fingertip; it does not hurt.
strings.Espera unos segundos: el aparato da la f: Wait a few seconds: the device gives the heart rate and the oxygen level.
strings.Lo que puede falsear la lectura, según l: What can distort the reading, according to the source: artificial nails, darker skin pigmentation, poor circulation, cold skin and tobacco.
strings.Will I need to do anything to prepare fo: Will I need to do anything to prepare for the test?, in the list opened by the previous sentence
strings.La lectura puede quedar entre un 2 % y u: The reading may be between 2 % and 4 % above or below the actual blood oxygen.
strings.Is there anything else I need to know ab: Is there anything else I need to know about pulse oximetry?
strings.Si en vuelo cambia algo de cómo se toma: Whether anything changes in flight about how pulse oximetry is taken: no source that says so has been read. The steps are those for Earth.
strings.Glucosa en sangre capilar con glucómetro: Capillary blood glucose with a glucose meter
strings.Comprueba que el glucómetro está cargado: Check that the glucose meter is charged and ready to use.
strings.Con las manos frías, caliéntalas antes d: With cold hands, warm them before washing them: cold reduces the blood reaching the fingertip and makes it hard to draw enough for the strip.
strings.More tips to keep in mind: More tips to keep in mind
strings.Lávate las manos con agua tibia y jabón,: Wash your hands with warm water and soap, and dry them well, before each measurement.
strings.Masajea o sacude la mano para que llegue: Massage or shake the hand so that blood reaches the finger.
strings.Pincha el dedo con la lanceta y, apretan: Prick the finger with the lancet and, squeezing from the base of the finger, gently place a small drop of blood on the strip.
strings.Mete la tira en el glucómetro: la lectur: Insert the strip into the glucose meter: the reading appears within a few seconds.
strings.Apunta la cifra y lo que pueda haberla a: Note the figure and anything that may have affected it, including whether you were fasting or when you last ate: the source says that how it is read depends on that.
strings.How to Prepare for the Test, en la lista: How to Prepare for the Test, in the list of how the test can be done
strings.Tira la lanceta y la tira a la basura, y: Throw the lancet and the strip in the waste, and do not share the measuring equipment, especially the lancets, with anyone.
strings.Guarda las tiras en su envase bien cerra: Keep the strips in their tightly closed container: humidity and extreme temperatures spoil them.
strings.Esta cifra es de sangre capilar del dedo: This figure is for capillary blood from the finger. Glucose from a venous lab test is another measurement, which the source takes to be more accurate, and EMMA records it under another code: they are not mixed.
strings.Si hay glucómetro a bordo de la ISS y si: Whether there is a glucose meter on board the ISS and whether it is used in flight: no source that says so has been read. What came up when searching (2026-11-04) were continuous glucose monitors worn by private crews, another instrument with another code, and they were not read.
strings.Cómo se pincha el dedo y se lleva la got: How the finger is pricked and the drop taken to the strip in microgravity: no source that says so has been read. The steps are those for Earth.
strings.Cuánta sangre pide la tira y cuántos seg: How much blood the strip needs and how many seconds the reading takes: it depends on the glucose meter, and the source only says «a small amount» and «a few seconds».
strings.En la estación espacial la masa corporal: On the space station body mass is not measured with a scale: in microgravity it is difficult, and two mass measurement devices are used, the Russian BMMD (by the oscillation of a spring) and NASA's SLAMMD (by Newton's second law, F = ma).
strings.Antes del vuelo la referencia se tomó co: Before flight the reference was taken with a scale, and the two onboard devices do not give the same figure: in that study, a mean difference of 1.1 kg between the closest measurements of one and the other.
strings.Los pasos para medirse en el SLAMMD o en: The steps to measure oneself on the SLAMMD or the BMMD (posture, restraint, repetitions): a NASA page with the procedure was searched for on 2026-11-03 and not found; without a source they are not written.
strings.Los pasos para pesarse en una báscula en: The steps to weigh oneself on a scale on Earth: no source has been read.
strings.Frecuencia cardiaca y variabilidad (puls: Heart rate and variability (pulse by hand and wearable)
strings.Para la frecuencia en reposo, descansa a: For the resting rate, rest for at least 10 minutes beforehand.
strings.A mano, en la muñeca: pon los dedos índi: By hand, at the wrist: place your index and middle fingers on the inside of the opposite wrist, below the base of the thumb, and press with flat fingers until you feel the pulse.
strings.Cuenta los latidos durante 1 minuto ente: Count the beats for 1 full minute, or for 30 seconds and multiply by 2: those are the beats per minute.
strings.El SDNN (una medida de la variabilidad): SDNN (a measure of variability) is only compared between recordings of the same duration.
strings.Texto completo, en la copia de Internet: Full text, in the Internet Archive copy of the article's page (see the note on the reference)
strings.Registra cada vez en condiciones y en un: Record each time under similar conditions and in a similar environment.
strings.Cómo se coloca y se ajusta cada wearable: How each wearable is placed and fitted: its manufacturer's manual says so, and EMMA has not read it.
strings.Si la regla de la misma duración vale ta: Whether the same-duration rule also holds for RMSSD: the sentence read from the standard speaks of SDNN.
strings.Si en vuelo cambia algo de cómo se toma: Whether anything changes in flight about how the pulse is taken: no source that says so has been read.
strings.La prueba breve (PVT-B) dura 3 minutos;: The brief test (PVT-B) lasts 3 minutes; the standard one, 10.
strings.Los estímulos salen a intervalos al azar: The stimuli appear at random intervals: 1 to 4 seconds in the PVT-B and 2 to 10 in the 10-minute one. The reaction time to each is measured.
strings.Pulsar sin estímulo, o en menos de 100 m: Pressing without a stimulus, or in under 100 milliseconds, counts as a false start.
strings.Si pasan 30 segundos sin respuesta, la p: If 30 seconds pass without a response, the test gives a warning and counts it as a lapse.
strings.Qué versión de la prueba pasa hoy la tri: Which version of the test the ISS crew takes today: it has not been read (what was read about the PVT says so too, GET /api/pvt/protocol).
strings.En la estación espacial, el sueño y la v: On the space station, sleep and wakefulness are recorded with a wrist actigraph, which measures the accelerations of its movements.
strings.En vuelo se registra por tandas de 14 dí: In flight it is recorded in 14-day runs, 60 days apart; during each run it is worn day and night, except on spacewalks or when operations do not allow it.
strings.El inicio y el final de cada sueño los m: The start and end of each sleep are marked by the analysis program, with a wake threshold chosen in it; efficiency is total sleep relative to time in bed.
strings.Sleep logs and actigraphy, en la lista d: Sleep logs and actigraphy, in the list of sleep variables
strings.Cómo se pone y se lleva el actígrafo (qu: How the actigraph is put on and worn (which wrist, how it is fitted, when it is taken off): its manufacturer's manual says so, and EMMA has not read it and does not say which actigraph is its own.
strings.Qué umbral de vigilia usa el análisis de: Which wake threshold is used by the analysis that sleep duration and efficiency come from: the source says the program lets it be chosen, not which one is used.
strings.Pasos para medir el sueño en Tierra: no: Steps to measure sleep on Earth: no source has been read. EMMA does not currently read sleep from Apple Health or Google Fit exports.
strings.Lo leído de cómo se autoinforma el estad: What was read about how state is self-reported on the space station is about another instrument, the Reaction Self Test: just before each PVT-B, on-screen 11-point scales on sleep quality (mornings only), workload (evenings only), stress, mental fatigue, physical exhaustion, tiredness and sleepiness. Mood is not on that list.
strings.Las anclas de la escala de ánimo de EMMA: The anchors of EMMA's mood scale, from 0 to 10 (0, «the most negative mood»; 10, «the most positive mood»), are an untested EMMA design decision: the scale is not a version of any mood questionnaire, and no source says how it is answered or what each point means. That is why this guide gives no steps.
strings.Un cuestionario de ánimo publicado que s: A published mood questionnaire given in flight, with its points and anchors: none has been read.
strings.Batería Cognition de NASA (diez pruebas,: NASA Cognition battery (ten tests, with the PVT)
strings.La batería son diez pruebas breves, que: The battery is ten brief tests, taken in their standard order: MPT, VOLT, F2B, AM, LOT, ERT, MRT, DSST, BART and, last, the PVT.
strings.De cada una de las diez pruebas hay 15 v: There are 15 different versions of each of the ten tests.
strings.Una sesión entera duró de media 37 minut: A whole session lasted 37 minutes on average in the study of 25 ISS astronauts (with a standard deviation of 25 minutes).
strings.Antes de ocho de las diez pruebas hay un: Before eight of the ten tests there is a practice round that can be done just before the test: it serves those taking it for the first time or after a long while.
strings.En el portátil se responde con el panel: On the laptop, responses are given with the touchpad, without connecting a mouse: in space there is none.
strings.En el estudio normativo de la batería, e: In the normative study of the battery, on Earth, participants were asked not to take it in the first hour after waking, nor after more than 16 hours awake, nor while ill.
strings.En ese mismo estudio, la prueba se pasab: In that same study, the test was taken in a place without distractions, and anything that might explain something odd in the data, such as a distraction, was noted.
strings.Antes de cada pasada, un cuestionario re: Before each run, a questionnaire collected that day's hours of sleep, the stimulants and depressants taken in the previous 6 hours and the level of alertness.
strings.Salir de la batería a medias no obliga a: Leaving the battery halfway does not mean starting again: the program remembers the last test finished and next time starts with the following one.
strings.De cada prueba se registra la velocidad,: For each test the speed, which is the mean of the response times in milliseconds, and the accuracy are recorded. The MPT has no accuracy, and in the BART the second figure is about risk, a proportion from 0 to 1.
strings.1. MPT (Motor Praxis Task): pulsas en cu: 1. MPT (Motor Praxis Task): you click on squares that appear at random on the screen, smaller each time. It measures sensorimotor speed: how fast you click each square.
strings.2. VOLT (Visual Object Learning Task): m: 2. VOLT (Visual Object Learning Task): you memorize three-dimensional figures and then pick the ones you saw from among seen and new figures. It measures visual learning and memory.
strings.3. F2B (Fractal 2-Back): salen figuras u: 3. F2B (Fractal 2-Back): figures appear one after another and you respond when the current one is the same as the one shown two before. It measures non-verbal working memory.
strings.4. AM (Abstract Matching): emparejas obj: 4. AM (Abstract Matching): you match objects with one of two pairs according to abstract rules that are not stated. It measures abstraction, problem solving and concept formation.
strings.5. LOT (Line Orientation Task): giras un: 5. LOT (Line Orientation Task): you rotate a line until it is parallel to another; the lines change in length and orientation. It measures visuospatial orientation.
strings.6. ERT (Emotion Recognition Task): ves f: 6. ERT (Emotion Recognition Task): you see photos of faces and pick one of five labels: happy, sad, angry, fearful or no emotion. It measures the recognition of emotions in faces.
strings.7. MRT (Matrix Reasoning Task): en una c: 7. MRT (Matrix Reasoning Task): a grid holds a pattern with a piece missing, and you pick the one that fits. It measures non-verbal abstract reasoning and pattern recognition.
strings.8. DSST (Digit Symbol Substitution Task): 8. DSST (Digit Symbol Substitution Task): with a key that pairs each digit with a symbol, you pick as fast as possible the number of the symbol shown. It lasts 90 seconds. It measures complex scanning, visual tracking and processing speed.
strings.9. BART (Balloon Analog Risk Test): infl: 9. BART (Balloon Analog Risk Test): you inflate an animated balloon or collect the reward; the balloon bursts after a number of pumps that you do not know and that changes on each trial. It measures risk-taking behavior.
strings.10. PVT (Psychomotor Vigilance Test): vi: 10. PVT (Psychomotor Vigilance Test): you watch a box and press the space bar as soon as a millisecond counter appears in it, as fast as you can and without pressing when there is no stimulus. Its steps are also in the PVT's own guide.
strings.En la estación espacial la batería corre: On the space station the battery runs on an HRF laptop, in the Columbus module; in the study of 25 astronauts it was taken on Hewlett Packard Z-Book 15 G2 laptops in all sessions.
strings.En ese estudio se pasó una vez antes del: In that study it was taken once before flight, twice in flight (within 30 days after launch and within 30 days before return) and twice afterwards (within 10 and within 30 days after landing).
strings.En el protocolo Standard Measures de NAS: In NASA's Standard Measures protocol, the battery is among the behavioral health and performance measures; on missions of 105 to 240 days, the data are taken during the first month, mid-flight and during the last month.
strings.Al acabar cada prueba, el resultado se c: When each test ends, the result is encrypted, saved to the laptop's disk and, if there is a connection, sent to a central server.
strings.Según el informe de evidencia del HRP, e: According to the HRP evidence report, on the ISS the battery is used in research studies, to describe cognitive performance on long flights and refine it with a view to possible operational use.
strings.Las instrucciones que da el programa en: The instructions the program gives on the screen of each test, word for word: they have not been read. What each test does comes from the articles that describe it.
strings.Si en vuelo se piden las mismas condicio: Whether the same conditions as in the normative study on Earth are asked for in flight (the hour after waking, the 16 hours awake, the place without distractions): no source read says so.
strings.Qué intervalos entre estímulos usa la PV: Which inter-stimulus intervals are used by the PVT of the battery that the crew takes today: the battery's article (2015) gives 2 to 5 seconds for its 3-minute version, and what was read about the PVT-B (2011) gives 1 to 4; which one runs today on the ISS has not been read.
